status_note: Provider, budgets and cadence are fixed by the 5,000-posts-per-day instruction. No provider call has been made. Parameters marked null are not frozen.

acquisition.windows: UTC half-open intervals; exchange calendar mapping
acquisition.sampling_policy: planned sample: time slices, query order and pages per group are frozen before each run and stored; never described as a random sample of the day or of X

twitterapi_io.time_operators: since_time:UNIX_SECONDS until_time:UNIX_SECONDS inside the query string
twitterapi_io.rate_limit_qps: checked 2026-11-23 on twitterapi.io/qps-limits: per account; 0.2 (one request per 5 seconds) for an account that never bought credits, 20 after any credit purchase
twitterapi_io.status_429_behaviour: HTTP 429 without Retry-After; observed 2026-11-23 on the second of two back-to-back requests

retry.applies_to: HTTP 503 on tweet/advanced_search, documented by the provider as not charged (read 2026-11-23). Every attempt is reserved in the ledger first. Unknown outcomes (timeout, 429, other status) are never retried in a run and keep their reservation.
retry.stale_cursor_note: A stored cursor older than this is not sent again: the unit is asked from its first page under a new query record (reason STALE_CURSOR) and the pages already stored are paid a second time. From the live ledger read on 2026-11-24: first pages 212 of 212 answered; continuation with a cursor under 1 h old failed 12%, 1-12 h 52%, 12-36 h 88% (HTTP 503, documented as not charged). Cursor age and time of day were not separated in that data.

acquisition.tolerated_max_posts_per_page_note: the documented page size is 20; a page of 22 was returned on 2026-11-23. Up to 25 a page is charged at its real count and cap checks keep headroom for it; a larger page pauses all requests
acquisition.history_anchor: last completed America/New_York calendar date at first run; exact UTC range persisted in the store
acquisition.query_min_faves_note: the like floor is applied after collection. A min_faves: operator in the query would cut paid volume, but the provider does not document it; not used until a bounded live check shows it works

account_rules.target_must_be_named_note: owner instruction of 2026-11-25: a post counts for QQQ only when its own text names QQQ; Nasdaq-100, sector and market talk stay under their own targets. The like floor is unchanged.

account_rules.status: PROPOSED_NUMBERS: the owner asked for higher weights for very large accounts and a 20-like floor; the tier cut-offs and weights are a first proposal and are NOT changed by the watch-list import. The two named accounts are identified through the private watch list (identity mapping only).
account_rules.basis: likeCount and author.followers as returned by the provider when the post was first fetched; not historical values
account_rules.known_bias: a post fetched soon after it was written has had little time to collect likes, so the floor removes late-in-the-day posts more often than early ones, and it is not comparable between the daily batch and the historical back-fill

exchange_calendar.note: Registered round9 XNYS sessions through 2026-02-27, extended to 2026-12-31 from the closures and early closes on the NYSE hours page read on 2026-11-22. See calendar/MANIFEST.json.

incremental.set_by: owner instruction of 2026-11-25: verify an update every two hours on the existing server
incremental.note: one page per query per run from where the query last succeeded; charged to the recent pool's existing shares. With 8 keyword queries and 12 runs a day, full pages give 1,920 posts, inside the 2,400 keyword share.

qqq-20261125.order: round 1: the regular-hours slice of every session, thinnest session first; round 2: the pre-open slice, thinnest first after round 1; stops at max_new_posts
qqq-20261125.set_by: owner instruction of 2026-11-25: at least 500, target 1,000 valid QQQ posts
qqq-20261125.note: planned sample. The like operator is the main sample's own 20-like floor moved into the search, so no page is paid for posts the rules would drop; the first page is checked and the job stops if the provider does not honour it. Replies are not asked for. Every post is fetched after the fact and marked RETROSPECTIVE_VISIBLE_NOW.

classifier.selection_basis: engineering candidate chosen for free local CPU inference on a 4-core / 7 GiB server; not claimed to be the best financial model
classifier.quality_note: no human-labelled sample exists; no accuracy, precision, recall or F1 is reported until one does
classifier.determinism_note: temperature 0 and a fixed seed; byte-identical output across hardware is not promised

prompt_history.why: real-model smoke on hand-written texts: the model filled the id fields with placeholders and gave inconsistent status/stance pairs; every output was rejected by the validator. No stored post was ever labelled with it.

classifier.identity_note: labels are matched on the hash of the full inference identity (model, revision, prompt, schema, every generation parameter, chat template, engine build, adapter); see stance.inference_identity

queues.order: recent: newest sample day first; history: oldest first; then topic, target, sha256(post id)

market.adjustment_semantics: moomoo daily bars with autype=1 (the vendor's adjusted series, as supplied when the bundle was built). Open and close come from the same adjusted series, so both ends of a return are treated alike. Whether cash dividends are folded into the adjustment has NOT been verified here: every figure is a price return of this adjusted series and is not called a total return.

candidate_input.note: The only local snapshot with a price-adjusted QQQ daily series. SPY is absent; SOX exists only unadjusted. Not frozen as the study input.

market.execution_return: adj_close[k+h-1]/adj_open[k]-1; k first open after committed signal

input.kind: registered immutable research bundle (a consistent copy, not the live quote store)
input.session_alignment: one price row for each of the 1,800 registered sessions from 2019-11-01 through 2026-11-17: none missing, none extra

market.branch: market-regime description (QQQ absolute path). Not the factor-residual / alpha target; QQQ is never regressed on itself.
market.after_last_date: sessions after 2026-11-17 have no price in this bundle: returns are null with the reason until a new bundle is registered

authorization.activation: after preflight if existing valid credential

recent.sub_pools_note: shares of the same 3,000-post / USD 0.45 recent pool by job type: watched authors 600 / 0.09, keyword search 2,400 / 0.36. They add no allowance. The preflight is charged to the pool and to the daily and rolling caps, not to either share.
